name: Colorado
overview: The 2025 Property Tax/Rent/Heat Credit rebate supports qualifying seniors' property-tax, rent, and heat costs; disabled residents may instead qualify for the Disability Assistance Credit.

programs.name: Property Tax/Rent/Heat Credit rebate
programs.ageRule: Age 65+ or surviving spouse age 58+ for 2025 PTC.
programs.incomeDefinition: Total income from all sources under the PTC instructions.
programs.maximumBenefit: Combined property/rent/heat rebate up to $1,178; property/rent component follows its own schedule.
programs.formulaSummary: Income- and expense-based property/rent and heat rebates; combined maximum is not solely property-tax relief.
programs.application: File 2025 DR 0104PTC; applications accepted through December 31, 2027.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year Colorado residence; cannot be another taxpayer's dependent.
Alternate identification procedure is available without SSN/ITIN.
interactions: PTC and Disability Assistance Credit cannot both be claimed for the same year.

researchNotes: From tax year 2025, disabled residents of any age may receive the refundable DAC ($400–$1,200 by income/status); it replaces their former PTC route and is income-based rather than a housing-expense credit.
DAC federal-AGI limits: $20,000 single/$32,000 joint; full-year qualifying disability benefits required.
Senior Housing Income Tax Credit is unavailable for tax year 2025.
